offers.description: Free inspection and professional valuation for used home furniture

mainEntity.name: Do you buy all types of home furniture?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes, we buy all types of home furniture regardless of type or condition: bedrooms, sofas, dining tables, cabinets, wardrobes, bookshelves, home decor, carpets, curtains, and everything related to the home. We value each piece individually and offer a fair price based on its condition and quality.

mainEntity.name: How is the price of used furniture determined?

acceptedAnswer.text: We set the price based on several factors: furniture type (wood, MDF, metal), overall condition (new, like-new, used), craftsmanship quality, brand if any, and market demand. Our specialist team has years of valuation experience and ensures you get a fair price that reflects true value.

mainEntity.name: Is the inspection free? Are there any moving fees?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes, the inspection is completely free across all Amman areas, at no cost to you. Moving is free too — we cover all costs of moving the furniture from your location once the deal is done. There are no hidden fees or extra costs.

mainEntity.name: How long does the selling process take?

acceptedAnswer.text: The process is very fast! After you contact us, we can schedule an inspection the same day or the next. Inspection usually takes 15-30 minutes, and once we agree on a price, we pay instantly and move the furniture the same day or at a time that suits you.
